title: Say Panpipilalek ed Sagradon Silir
intro: Onloob ka ed mareen a santuaryo tan anengneng mo so sakey a debosyonadon lingkor nen Allah ya akaalagey a manpipikasi. Saray lima ra so akatagey, saray mata ra so akatagey, tan say puso ra so walaan na pilalek ya abayag la ed interon bilay da. Siopa iyan maanos a kamarerwa ya agbalot kinmupas so talek to ed si Allah?
clues: Abayag ak ya nandayew tan nampikasi, ya anengneng ko ray milagro ya amabiskeg ed pananisiak.
Niiter ed siak so responsabilidad ya mangasikaso ed sakey ya abendisyonan ya malangwer nin kamarerwa diad santuaryo.
Nen ontatakken ak la, say sankaermenan ko et anggapoy anak ko, ta lepes so asawak tan maedad kami lan dua.
Impikasi ko ed Katawan ko so onsublay ed mismon pamilyak, sakey a toon mangituloy ed legasiya na inkapropeta.
Nen akaalagey ak ed panagpikasian, tinawag ak na saray anghel, ya inkuan da, 'Si Allah so mangiter ed sika na maliket a balita', tan siak so tinmakot tan mankelaw.
Nibaga ed siak ya nawalaan ak na anak a laki ya manngaran na Yahya, sakey a ngaran ya agnin balot niiter ed siopaman nensaman, tan bilang tanda et agak mitongtong ed totoo ed loob na taloy agew.

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say inkabaog tan itatatken legan ya pipilaleken so matunong a mananawir
Say pangibantak ed mandarlang ya apoy
Say inakmon na baleg a sira
Say pakawalaan na panarian ed sakey a managpairap
trial.answer: Say inkabaog tan itatatken legan ya pipilaleken so matunong a mananawir

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Say baston ya nagmaliw ya uleg
Say kabatyan a kamelyo nen Allah

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Niiter so matunong ya anak tan nansalita lamet kayari na taloy agew ya ag-inmesel
Niiter so malaknab a panarian tan panangontrol ed dagem
outcome.answer: Niiter so matunong ya anak tan nansalita lamet kayari na taloy agew ya ag-inmesel

arabic: وَإِنِّى خِفْتُ ٱلْمَوَٰلِىَ مِن وَرَآءِى وَكَانَتِ ٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرًۭا فَهَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ وَلِيًّۭا
verse: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir (19:5)
